## Overview[Direct link to heading](https://help.lob.com/print-and-mail/integrations/api-integrations/hubspot\#overview-1)

Hubspot is a popular marketing automation software tool. In early 2022, Hubspot added Custom Code functionality to their Workflows, enabling a direct connection to Lob. Hubspot’s Workflows can be used to automatically trigger a mailpiece to be sent, via Lob.

## Step-by-step walkthrough[Direct link to heading](https://help.lob.com/print-and-mail/integrations/api-integrations/hubspot\#step-by-step-walkthrough-3)

### Create accounts[Direct link to heading](https://help.lob.com/print-and-mail/integrations/api-integrations/hubspot\#create-accounts)

A developer plan for testing with Lob is free, but you will need to [create a Lob account](https://dashboard.lob.com/login) to get your API Keys.

If you do not already have one, [create a Hubspot account here](https://app.hubspot.com/signup-hubspot/crm?uuid=ff52f537-4146-48e8-8cd2-8545c26b767d&step=landing_page). You’ll want to enable Operations Hub / Marketing Hub Professional trial (note this lasts 14 days): **Automation > Workflows > Start 14 Day Trial**

This integration requires a paid Hubspot plan. The Custom code workflow action requires an Operations Hub subscription (Starter tier or above), or an equivalent Professional/Enterprise-tier Hub with Custom Code actions enabled.

Not sure what your org has? In Hubspot, navigate to Automation > Workflows, add an action, and look for Custom code under Data ops. **If it's greyed out or prompts an upgrade, you'll need to upgrade your subscription before continuing.**

### Create contacts[Direct link to heading](https://help.lob.com/print-and-mail/integrations/api-integrations/hubspot\#create-contacts)

You can create manually, or import from a CSV by clicking **Contacts > Import**. From there, walk through the flow to import a file from your computer: **Start an Import > File From Computer > One File > One Object > Contacts**. Ensure your contacts have address parameters; you can [use this CSV](https://s3.us-west-2.amazonaws.com/public.lob.com/solutions/Hubspot_demo/Hubspot_demo_Contacts_10.csv) as an example.

We will be creating a list in the next step, so for this walkthrough, do not select “Create a List from this Import”.

In the Map File screen, for ‘ **Address2**’, select ‘ **Create A New Property**’, and name it ‘ **Address2**’.

![](https://help.lob.com/~gitbook/image?url=https%3A%2F%2F1775164782-files.gitbook.io%2F%7E%2Ffiles%2Fv0%2Fb%2Fgitbook-x-prod.appspot.com%2Fo%2Fspaces%252FiXDYGxBp6aAwhpEhTMNC%252Fuploads%252FtoA13sfRa3bwHZuRpL7e%252Fimage.png%3Falt%3Dmedia%26token%3D037679cf-a0b3-41b7-8ff3-0e2413a86008&width=768&dpr=3&quality=100&sign=6e998df98dda2711315649d352df9aab&sv=3)

### Create a List[Direct link to heading](https://help.lob.com/print-and-mail/integrations/api-integrations/hubspot\#create-a-list-5)

**Contacts** \> **Segments (Lists)** \> **Create Segment > Create a segment of Contacts > Add filter > Memberships > Import membership > Select the CSV you just imported.**

![](https://help.lob.com/~gitbook/image?url=https%3A%2F%2F1775164782-files.gitbook.io%2F%7E%2Ffiles%2Fv0%2Fb%2Fgitbook-x-prod.appspot.com%2Fo%2Fspaces%252FiXDYGxBp6aAwhpEhTMNC%252Fuploads%252FWp59fsC7yQwSwygG0bg0%252Fimage.png%3Falt%3Dmedia%26token%3D5c5ae5ae-c7d0-4e59-90fa-8fa502483308&width=768&dpr=3&quality=100&sign=5608c7f6a78456dfe52fbd1ba2ff87f3&sv=3)

Choose processing type "Static", then save and process segment.

### Create a Workflow[Direct link to heading](https://help.lob.com/print-and-mail/integrations/api-integrations/hubspot\#create-a-workflow-6)

Select **Automation** \> **Workflows**

![](https://help.lob.com/~gitbook/image?url=https%3A%2F%2F1775164782-files.gitbook.io%2F%7E%2Ffiles%2Fv0%2Fb%2Fgitbook-x-prod.appspot.com%2Fo%2Fspaces%252FiXDYGxBp6aAwhpEhTMNC%252Fuploads%252FRgHLVqF58GirNm37o6Fr%252Fimage.png%3Falt%3Dmedia%26token%3D0b901e1a-cdb0-40e4-972c-fcc90b31f2eb&width=768&dpr=3&quality=100&sign=8a446b3b77d17866c0a627bef0a7d5a0&sv=3)

Click **Create Workflow > From scratch**

![](https://help.lob.com/~gitbook/image?url=https%3A%2F%2F1775164782-files.gitbook.io%2F%7E%2Ffiles%2Fv0%2Fb%2Fgitbook-x-prod.appspot.com%2Fo%2Fspaces%252FiXDYGxBp6aAwhpEhTMNC%252Fuploads%252FDnFLuO4uI5JTPlskw7lp%252Fimage.png%3Falt%3Dmedia%26token%3D0f3ea115-aeac-4eb1-8dd0-b37964a3e6dc&width=300&dpr=3&quality=100&sign=b6dc96de6d92ab050a51503671457206&sv=3)

### Set Up Trigger[Direct link to heading](https://help.lob.com/print-and-mail/integrations/api-integrations/hubspot\#set-up-trigger)

For example, **List Memberships** \> **Select List you previously created** \> **Is Member of List**

![](https://help.lob.com/~gitbook/image?url=https%3A%2F%2F1775164782-files.gitbook.io%2F%7E%2Ffiles%2Fv0%2Fb%2Fgitbook-x-prod.appspot.com%2Fo%2Fspaces%252FiXDYGxBp6aAwhpEhTMNC%252Fuploads%252FEvFgl6J6tkzzVYmzNlcF%252Fimage.png%3Falt%3Dmedia%26token%3Db9410b20-1c97-4065-b8a4-e4c764920d2e&width=768&dpr=3&quality=100&sign=3653e4521f5f808b3a4e975bd3abd0c0&sv=3)

### Create a resulting Action[Direct link to heading](https://help.lob.com/print-and-mail/integrations/api-integrations/hubspot\#create-a-resulting-action-7)

Click **+** button on Workflow, beneath the Trigger, then from the **Data ops** dropdown, select **Custom code**

![](https://help.lob.com/~gitbook/image?url=https%3A%2F%2F1775164782-files.gitbook.io%2F%7E%2Ffiles%2Fv0%2Fb%2Fgitbook-x-prod.appspot.com%2Fo%2Fspaces%252FiXDYGxBp6aAwhpEhTMNC%252Fuploads%252FIxtLtBxEYF89uL8wRs2G%252Fimage.png%3Falt%3Dmedia%26token%3D8284b9c4-4a2d-4657-80a1-1562b3d101b8&width=768&dpr=3&quality=100&sign=972e40159f5dd38664ef6c7bbd366457&sv=3)

Here you can select Python or NodeJS. For this example, we will select **Language: Python**. Then we will map Lob’s API fields to Hubspot properties, and enter our custom code. For this example, **Map Properties To Include in Code** as follows:

![](https://help.lob.com/~gitbook/image?url=https%3A%2F%2F1775164782-files.gitbook.io%2F%7E%2Ffiles%2Fv0%2Fb%2Fgitbook-x-prod.appspot.com%2Fo%2Fspaces%252FiXDYGxBp6aAwhpEhTMNC%252Fuploads%252FrY4Yg8uK9prxVmOI0QiJ%252Fimage.png%3Falt%3Dmedia%26token%3D545ab693-4c0e-4d5e-8a4e-2aecf4ebd20c&width=768&dpr=3&quality=100&sign=528ab891938bfd0849f2012e37d24141&sv=3)

Finally, enter your Python code, with properties defined as per the prior step. See example code below to test with.

#### Example Python code[Direct link to heading](https://help.lob.com/print-and-mail/integrations/api-integrations/hubspot\#example-python-code-8)

Copy

```
import requests
import json
import base64
import os
from hubspot import HubSpot
from hubspot.crm.contacts import ApiException
from requests.adapters import HTTPAdapter
from urllib3.util.retry import Retry

def retry_session(retries, session=None, backoff_factor=1):
    session = session or requests.Session()
    retry = Retry(
        total=retries,
        read=retries,
        connect=retries,
        backoff_factor=backoff_factor,
        status_forcelist=[500, 502, 503, 504, 429],
        allowed_methods=['POST']
    )
    adapter = HTTPAdapter(max_retries=retry)
    session.mount('http://', adapter)
    session.mount('https://', adapter)
    return session

def main(event):
    address = event.get('inputFields').get('address')
    address2 = event.get('inputFields').get('address2')
    city = event.get('inputFields').get('city')
    state = event.get('inputFields').get('state')
    zip_code = event.get('inputFields').get('zip_code')
    email = event.get('inputFields').get('email')
    hs_object_id = event.get('inputFields').get('hs_object_id')
    phone = event.get('inputFields').get('phone')
    firstname = event.get('inputFields').get('firstname')
    lastname = event.get('inputFields').get('lastname')

    url = "https://api.lob.com/v1/postcards"

    payload = {
        "description": "HUBSPOT DEMO POSTCARD",
        "to[name]": firstname + ' ' + lastname,
        "to[address_line1]": address,
        "to[address_line2]": address2,
        "to[address_city]": city,
        "to[address_state]": state,
        "to[address_zip]": zip_code,
        "front": "https://s3.us-west-2.amazonaws.com/public.lob.com/solutions/retail_pdfs/4x6+Retail+front.pdf",
        "back": "https://s3.us-west-2.amazonaws.com/public.lob.com/solutions/retail_pdfs/4x6+Retail+back.pdf",
        "size": "4x6",
        "metadata[customer_id]": hs_object_id,
        "metadata[campaign]": "HUBSPOT_TEST",
        "metadata[phone]": phone,
        "metadata[email]": email,
        "metadata[front_creative_name]": "demo_hubspot_front_creative",
        "metadata[back_creative_name]": "demo_hubspot_back_creative",
        "metadata[address_city]": city,
        "metadata[address_state]": state,
        "metadata[address_zip]": zip_code
    }

    session = retry_session(retries=5)
    r = session.post(url, auth=requests.auth.HTTPBasicAuth(YOUR_API_KEY, ''), data=payload)
    j = r.json()
    print(j)
```

If copying and pasting the Python code above, it is advised to run it through a Python code validator to ensure that no formatting issues occur as a result.

### Add your API Keys[Direct link to heading](https://help.lob.com/print-and-mail/integrations/api-integrations/hubspot\#add-your-api-keys-11)

Next we need API credentials from our Lob account. Retrieve these credentials from your Lob dashboard by clicking on the **Settings** menu on the sidebar, then clicking on the API Keys tab.

In the example Python code, replace `YOUR_API_KEY` with your **Test API Key**.

**ENSURE YOU ARE USING YOUR TEST API KEY**

### **Update Creative**[Direct link to heading](https://help.lob.com/print-and-mail/integrations/api-integrations/hubspot\#update-creative)

You should also replace the front and back "`HUBSPOT_CREATIVE`" with your own HTML, template IDs, or links to hosted static creatives. For example:

Copy

```
"front": "https://s3.us-west-2.amazonaws.com/public.lob.com/solutions/retail_pdfs/4x6+Retail+front.pdf",
```

Copy

```
"back": "https://s3.us-west-2.amazonaws.com/public.lob.com/solutions/retail_pdfs/4x6+Retail+back.pdf",
```

### Testing[Direct link to heading](https://help.lob.com/print-and-mail/integrations/api-integrations/hubspot\#testing-9)

Make sure to hit **‘Save’.** Then you can open your custom code back up, scroll to the bottom of the panel, and click **Test Action.** Select a contact, and click **Test** to fire off a test request.

![](https://help.lob.com/~gitbook/image?url=https%3A%2F%2F1775164782-files.gitbook.io%2F%7E%2Ffiles%2Fv0%2Fb%2Fgitbook-x-prod.appspot.com%2Fo%2Fspaces%252FiXDYGxBp6aAwhpEhTMNC%252Fuploads%252FrC0zzJpDx1WxbXqjj2uH%252Fimage.png%3Falt%3Dmedia%26token%3D97f9e051-6d4f-4ce6-8112-bb4fa16ffad5&width=768&dpr=3&quality=100&sign=49d0920987bac39ecbd85eab959e38ef&sv=3)

You can then log into your Lob account to verify that a mailpiece was generated.

### Utilizing workflow[Direct link to heading](https://help.lob.com/print-and-mail/integrations/api-integrations/hubspot\#utilizing-workflow-10)

Once you’ve tested, you can **Publish** your workflow. From there, it will run whenever the trigger you set is fired. For example, if you followed the above example, you can now add some contacts to your list. This should automatically create mailpieces for each person on the list.

Now you can replace the Test API key in your Python code with your Base64 Encoded Live API Key, and your Automation is live. If you are using other test resources like address IDs or template IDs, those will also need to be transferred to your live environment.
